blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon on Wednesday testified in the graft trial of former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co and his co-accused. This case stemmed from the P289.4-million worth Sunwest project in Oriental Mindoro’s Naujan town which state prosecutors said was found to have serious structural deficiencies. Dizon, who inspected the project in September last year, discovered that the road dike only has a three-meter steel sheet pile (SSP), which is far from the 12-meter requirement. “Talagang kitang-kita mo yung kababuyan na ginawa nila dito (We really saw the disgraceful thing that they did here),” Dizon said in an […]...
